title: EAEA: Evidence-Aware Energy Attribution - reference implementation and data
description: Python reference implementation (numpy only), fixed-seed synthetic evaluation and deterministic case study accompanying the preprint 'Who Pays for the Bit? Evidence-Aware Energy Attribution Across Shared 5G and 6G Network Infrastructure'. All service-level results are synthetic; the only published measurements used are a macro base-station power model and a server idle-power figure.
